They sell the {{Item|Shady Ring}} and its upgrades to the player. == Shop == '''Lucius''' will sell a line of [[Accessories]] to the player after they have purchased certain amounts of items from the [[Dark Auction]]. These Accessories give discounts at most NPC shops.
